description: List scheduled shifts in a time window — who works when, where and in which position — optionally including open shifts and unpublished drafts. Answers "who is on on Friday?" and "what open shifts are left?". When I Work: GET /2/shifts.

deleted.description: Also return deleted_ids: shifts deleted in the window.

end.description: End of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

include_allopen.description: Include open shifts across all schedules — manager or admin.

include_open.description: Include open (unassigned) shifts from the user's schedules.

include_repeating_shifts_to.description: Also expand repeating shift series up to this date. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

include_swaps.description: Include swap requests attached to the shifts.

start.description: Start of the window. Date-time, e.g. 2026-10-05T08:00:00-05:00 (When I Work's own examples also use RFC 2822, e.g. "Mon, 05 Oct 2026 08:00:00 -0500").

unpublished.description: Include unpublished (draft) shifts — supervisor or above.

name: wheniwork_list_shifts
title: List shifts
